description: Add LRU eviction (bounded capacity) plus per-entry TTL expiry to an unbounded cache
prompts: cache.go's Cache is an unbounded map wrapper - Get/Put never evict anything. Turn it into an LRU cache with a TTL: NewCache(capacity int, ttl int64) takes a max size and a time-to-live in seconds. Put(key string, value int, now int64) stores a value timestamped at `now`. Get(key string, now int64) returns (value, true) if present AND not expired (now - storedAt < ttl), else (0, false) - and an expired entry must be REMOVED the moment it's observed to be stale. Both Get and Put must refresh a key's recency. When Put would exceed `capacity`, evict the LEAST recently used entry (recency = most recent Get OR Put) before inserting the new one.
name: add_go_lru_cache_with_ttl
